findings.title: `wc -l` output compared trimmed-vs-untrimmed fails on BSD wc (test_merge.sh D and E)
nothing asserts `orchid merge` exports ORCHID_MERGE_GATE_ACTIVE into the gate's environment — the half of the guard that actually terminates the loop
a gate failure carrying no `file:line:` output yields no rework brief at all, leaving the implementer a log it cannot read
kernel.md's "read from repo config ONLY" is false — `config_get` also honours `ORCHID_MERGE_GATE` and `~/.orchid/config`
`runners/orchid-drive:2288` reports every merge-time rework as "merge validation failed", contradicting the new PROTOCOL requirement to say which one fired
